coding_note: Prospective corps member posted to Imo State, abducted at Rumuokoro after relatives dropped him off to travel to camp; ransom paid but he was never released or found, and suspects were charged over his death.
Serving corps members returning from the bank in their host community were robbed; one was taken away and released two days later. Kidnapping coded as the most serious harm; number robbed not stated.

Five corps members abducted on the Owerri-Port Harcourt Expressway while travelling to Rivers and Akwa Ibom; the report does not say whether the journey was to camp or to a posting, so stage and status are unknown.
Corps member abducted by Boko Haram in January 2019 and released in June 2019; activity at the time of abduction not reported.

Corps members serving as INEC ad hoc staff abducted during the presidential and National Assembly elections in their state of service; incidents in Uruan and Ikono LGAs reported together, so LGA is left blank; some released after security intervention.
Serving corps member abducted on her way to a community development service meeting at Ilamija; ransom demanded but not paid; rescued by police.
Four prospective corps members abducted on the Funtua-Gusau road on their way to the Gusau orientation camp; rescued by police with help from repentant bandits.

Two prospective corps members travelling from Benue to the Kebbi and Sokoto camps abducted by bandits on the Tsafe-Gusau road; released with four other passengers after ransom demands. May be linked to the abduction reported for 20 October in the same LGA, but no report connects them.
Prospective corps member on the way to the Kebbi orientation camp abducted with other passengers in Tsafe LGA; escaped after four days and went on to camp.
A corps member among six people abducted on the Obollo Afor-Nkalagu road after a community security meeting; the report does not link the journey to service duties or give the outcome.
Fifteen corps members travelling to Lagos at the end of the orientation course in Imo State were intercepted at Ihiala; rescued unhurt by police the same day [A05].
Seven corps members abducted while travelling to Rivers State after the orientation course in Ondo State; released about a week later at Rumuji; one family reported paying ransom [A05].

Eight prospective corps members travelling by state transport bus from Uyo to the Sokoto camp abducted on the Funtua-Gusau road; ransom demanded; all freed by August 2024, the last after a year in captivity; NYSC states no ransom was paid.

Two corps members abducted by bandits at Yargoje while travelling from Edo to Katsina; rescued on 2 November 2023. The abduction date is not reported, so the month of rescue is used, and the reports do not link the journey to service duties.

Corps members returning from the orientation camp abducted on the Ifon-Owo road; the driver and a female passenger were killed; ransom paid and the captives abandoned under police pressure [A05, C05].
Prospective corps members among about 35 passengers abducted from three buses on the Enugu-Nsukka road; one was travelling to NYSC service in Kogi State; number of corps members not stated.
Prospective corps member abducted on the Kogi axis on the way to the Taraba orientation camp; N30 million demanded; still held as last reported on 30 January 2026.
Corps members travelling in two commercial buses to Abuja after the orientation course in Bayelsa State abducted on the Itobe-Onicha-Igo axis; all rescued by security forces within a week [A05, C02].

Prospective corps members travelling from Ibadan to orientation camps in Akwa Ibom and Abia abducted from two buses on the Owerri-Onitsha road at Umunoha; 10 victims rescued the same day; the rest still held as last reported [C03, C04].
